docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
The first Chinese graduate of an American university tells of Yale, the Taiping rebellion and the Chinese Educational Mission he led.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

Yung Wing (1828–1912), My Life in China and America, 1909, with an introduction by Joseph H. Twichell (1838–1918). This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Standard Ebooks edition, CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication); transcription originally from Project Gutenberg. Modified: converted to this format.
